prompts.causal_counterfactual: The intact ice cube is suddenly replaced by a finished puddle covering the same plate area.
prompts.causal_positive: The same ice cube becomes progressively smaller as liquid water spreads outward in a growing puddle on the plate.
prompts.semantic: A clear ice cube on a shallow plate gradually shrinks while a puddle of water grows around it. Initial scene: A fixed close three-quarter view of one intact clear ice cube centered on a shallow plate. The cube has crisp visible boundaries, the surrounding plate surface is dry and exposed, and both the full cube and nearby plate area occupy enough of the frame for reliable size and surface-area inspection. Required visible entities: one clear ice cube; one shallow plate; exposed plate area around the cube. At the beginning: ice cube: intact, clearly bounded, and near full initial size; plate: shallow with a dry exposed surface around the ice. Required layout: ice cube is centered within the plate; enough surrounding plate area is visible for puddle growth; cube boundary and plate surface are unobstructed. Required state changes: ice visible size: large to progressively smaller; ice boundary: sharp to receding; water area: minimal to progressively larger. These event variables are allowed to change: ice-cube size and boundary; solid fraction and visible ice presence; liquid-water area on the plate. Preserve throughout: static close camera; plate identity and position; background and lighting; one clear ice cube and its resulting water; one shallow plate; the same material system and camera view.
